types.name: A workspace monorepo: applications in apps/, shared packages in packages/, a database package

layers.name: server-apps
layers.responsibility: Deployable servers and workers: each owns its endpoints or jobs and reaches data only through the database package

layers.name: client-apps
layers.responsibility: Deployable clients (web, admin, mobile): screens and their state, calling the servers' contracts

layers.name: database
layers.responsibility: The one package that owns the schema, the migrations and the queries

layers.name: packages
layers.responsibility: Shared libraries (UI kits, players, brand, observability, secrets): used by applications, never using them

layers.name: core-packages
layers.responsibility: The leaves every package may use: configuration and shared types, depending on nothing of the repository

infrastructure_baseline.item: Every push runs lint, type check, tests and the EAOS debt gate
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Without a gate each change can reintroduce what the audit removed.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: The default branch cannot receive a change whose checks fail.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Behaviour-lock specs for every feature plus unit tests for domain logic
infrastructure_baseline.reason: The lock catches what users would notice; unit tests catch the rule that broke it.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: E4 = 1 and every feature spec passes on the default branch.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Browser errors and slow requests are reported with a release tag (OpenTelemetry, or an error tracker)
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A vibe-coded app fails silently in the user's browser; nobody learns of it.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every uncaught error reaches the tracker within a minute, tagged with the release.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Only publishable keys reach the browser; every secret lives in the host's secret store
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Anything bundled into the frontend is public.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: No secret-class credential in the repository or the bundle (EAOS H1 finds none).

infrastructure_baseline.item: Automated, grouped dependency updates with the vulnerability scan in CI
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A locked vulnerable version stays until someone looks.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: No locked version with a fixed high or critical advisory older than 14 days.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Every deployable application declares its build and start in the repository (Dockerfile, railway.json, Procfile)
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A host configured only in a dashboard cannot be rebuilt or reviewed.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: A clean checkout deploys each application with one documented command.

infrastructure_baseline.item: The database package owns every schema change as a versioned migration
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Two applications changing one schema drift apart.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: A clean database reaches production's schema from the migrations alone.

infrastructure_baseline.reason: Scattered import.meta.env reads fail at runtime, on the screen that first needs the value.

types.name: React + Vite frontend with its own Node server and a relational database

layers.name: pages
layers.responsibility: The shell and the route table: which screen answers which path; composes features, holds no logic

layers.name: features
layers.responsibility: One module per screen family, and the shared shell, stores and hooks every screen uses

layers.name: engine
layers.responsibility: The domain rules as pure, deterministic code: same inputs, same output, no I/O; shared by browser and server

layers.name: api-client
layers.responsibility: The only browser code that knows the server's endpoints: one typed call per endpoint

layers.name: ui
layers.responsibility: Presentational components with no data access and no domain rule

layers.name: lib
layers.responsibility: Pure helpers: formatting, dates, types; nothing that knows the domain or the network

layers.name: config
layers.responsibility: One typed module per side that reads the environment once and fails at start on a missing value

layers.name: server-entry
layers.responsibility: Process start: HTTP server, static files, shutdown; wires routes and infrastructure, holds no rule

layers.name: routes
layers.responsibility: HTTP endpoints: parse, authorise through security, call a service, shape the response; never SQL

layers.name: services
layers.responsibility: Application use cases: one operation per function, transactions and domain rules, no HTTP

layers.name: security
layers.responsibility: Authentication, sessions, authorisation policy, rate limits and headers

layers.name: server-domain
layers.responsibility: Server-side domain types and rules (permissions, roles, tokens) with no I/O

layers.name: data-access
layers.responsibility: The only code that speaks SQL: connections, row-level security, queries and migrations

layers.name: infrastructure
layers.responsibility: Cross-cutting services: HTTP transport, logging, telemetry, health, e-mail and calendar delivery, idempotency

infrastructure_baseline.reason: Scattered import.meta.env reads fail at runtime, on the screen that first needs the value.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: No file outside the config module reads the environment; a missing variable stops the build or start with its name.

infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: The default branch cannot receive a change whose checks fail.

infrastructure_baseline.reason: The lock catches what users would notice; unit tests catch the rule that broke it.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: E4 = 1 and every feature spec passes on the default branch.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Browser errors and slow requests are reported with a release tag (OpenTelemetry, or an error tracker)
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A vibe-coded app fails silently in the user's browser; nobody learns of it.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every uncaught error reaches the tracker within a minute, tagged with the release.

infrastructure_baseline.reason: Anything bundled into the frontend is public.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: No secret-class credential in the repository or the bundle (EAOS H1 finds none).

infrastructure_baseline.item: Automated, grouped dependency updates with the vulnerability scan in CI
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A locked vulnerable version stays until someone looks.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: No locked version with a fixed high or critical advisory older than 14 days.

infrastructure_baseline.item: The database schema and every change to it live in versioned migrations the server applies at start
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A schema changed by hand in production cannot be rebuilt, reviewed or rolled back.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: A clean database reaches the production schema by running the migrations alone; no table is created outside them.

infrastructure_baseline.item: One migration tool owns the schema (the project's own runner, or node-pg-migrate, Drizzle Kit or Prisma Migrate)
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Two ways of changing the schema drift apart.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every table and column is introduced by a numbered migration in the repository.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Automated database backups, and a restore rehearsed on a copy
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A backup is proven only by a restore.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: The last restore drill passed within 30 days, with its time recorded.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Every request is authorised on the server, per tenant, and the database enforces the same isolation (row-level security or scoped queries)
infrastructure_baseline.reason: An isolation checked only in the interface is one crafted request away from a leak.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: An isolation test reads nothing of another tenant through any endpoint; the database refuses a query without its scope.

infrastructure_baseline.item: The deployment target and its start command are declared in the repository (Dockerfile, railway.json, Procfile)
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A host configured only in a dashboard cannot be rebuilt or reviewed.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: A clean checkout deploys with one documented command, and the server answers its health route.

types.name: Python desktop application (a local UI packaged into an executable)

layers.name: ui
layers.responsibility: Screens and widgets (Streamlit views, Qt windows): read state, call services, render

layers.name: services
layers.responsibility: Use cases the UI calls; orchestrate domain and infrastructure

layers.name: domain
layers.responsibility: Rules and calculations with no I/O

layers.name: infrastructure
layers.responsibility: Database, files, network, market data

layers.name: entry
layers.responsibility: Launchers and packaging

infrastructure_baseline.item: Settings in the user's data directory (platformdirs), read once at start
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Writing next to the executable fails when it is installed read-only.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: The app starts from a read-only install location.

infrastructure_baseline.item: One schema owner with versioned migrations for the local database
infrastructure_baseline.reason: An upgrade that changes a table silently corrupts old data files.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Opening a data file from any earlier release upgrades it or refuses with a message.

infrastructure_baseline.item: CI runs the tests and builds the executable on every push
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A packaging break is found by the user who downloads it.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every release artefact is built by CI from a tagged commit.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Unit tests for domain calculations and approval tests for services
infrastructure_baseline.reason: Money and retirement maths must not change silently.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every public domain function is covered; the approval tests pass on the default branch.

infrastructure_baseline.item: A rotating local log with an export for support
infrastructure_baseline.reason: On a user's machine there is nothing else to look at.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: Every crash leaves a log with the version and the stack.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Any API token in the operating system keychain, never in the bundle
infrastructure_baseline.reason: A token in the executable belongs to everyone who has it.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: No credential in the repository or the built executable.

infrastructure_baseline.item: User data exported and restorable from the UI
infrastructure_baseline.reason: The only copy of a user's portfolio is on their disk.
infrastructure_baseline.success_measure: A backup restores into a clean install with identical totals.

infrastructure_baseline.item: Behaviour lock plus unit tests for services

infrastructure_baseline.item: Unit tests plus approval tests of command output
